source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Immediately after the dose is given.","B":"Halfway through the dosing interval.","C":"Immediately before the next scheduled dose.","D":"Only after amikacin has been permanently discontinued."}}
source_row.rationale: Mayo Clinic Laboratories directs that an amikacin trough specimen be collected immediately before the next scheduled dose. Option C is correct. Immediately after dosing is closer to a peak context, random midpoint timing is not a trough, and testing is performed during therapy rather than only after discontinuation.
source_row.source_detail: Ordering Guidance: a trough specimen should be collected immediately before the next scheduled dose; a peak specimen is collected 30-60 minutes after the last dose. Current Mayo Clinic Laboratories test catalog entry RAMIK/37033; live-rechecked 2026-08-15. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Physiological Integrity — Reduction of Risk Potential: diagnostic/laboratory interpretation, postprocedure monitoring, device management and potential complications. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
